technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term trend indicators bullish but major moving averages bearish, negative momentum, and price below key EMAs/SMAs create conflicting directional bias unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest with earnings in 90 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (30/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (103.9) indicates extreme market stress; MMM as industrial multinational faces significant near-term volatility despite 90-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term trend indicators (supertrend, PSAR, Hull) are bullish and price is near support (68.99) in a fear-driven market (VIX 103.9) offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all major moving averages (EMA/SMA 21 and 50), momentum is negative (RSI 43, MACD negative, CMF negative), macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), and fundamental conviction is absent—creating high-probability failure setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (supertrend, PSAR, Hull) are bullish and price sits at support in a fear-driven market, but this is outweighed by price below all major moving averages, negative momentum across RSI/MACD/CMF, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis).
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment is severely unfavourable with inverted yield curve signalling recession risk and VIX at crisis levels (103.9); MMM as an industrial multinational faces significant downside risk if market stress intensifies before earnings in 90 days.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 6 other Industrials positions (19% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk and reduces conviction further given weak fundamental and sentiment signals.
